# omadafusion_site (Data Source)

Looks up a site by name. Defaults to the provider `site`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omadafusion_site" "main" {
  name = "Default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Site name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Site ID.
